lenses.description: Stakeholder spec — what a stakeholder needs from the system.
System spec — a capability or behaviour at the system level.
Software spec — observable, verifiable behaviour of a component.
Architecture spec — a structural rule or design decision.
Non-functional spec — a quality attribute such as performance or security.
Constraint — an invariant that must always hold.
Domain entity — a data shape the system owns, with its attributes and invariants.

waivers.reason: stakeholder needs are verified by acceptance, not by an automated test
compile-checked anchoring is enforced by tsc, not by a unit test
an entity's shape is anchored by its realizing type and verified by review, not by a runtime test
